Hi, I want to share with y’all our banking experience for the first time , with my wife arriving less than two weeks . So she received B1 from ministry of interior, I was thinking at first maybe she should use Neema, we tried online but then they wrote us to proceed to the point of service so we gave up. Yesterday we went to bank hapoalim , it was too hectic, the schedule wasn’t very flexible.. only to make appointments next week for morning hours, so we left and went to Leumi, they received us with open arms and in the same morning no appointment needed; and they were very nice, very professional , the first person to attend to us was the floor / branch manager that even convinced me to move from my bank to them and gave me and my wife a year off fees; they ordered for my wife and me debit cards 💳 and registered the banking app and helped us with everything they could. 
This was in Ramla branch. 
A very good experience , i recommend this branch , 10/10.
